name: sparx
tagline: A complete, multi-module starter site — shop, journal, booking, and wholesale — in the sparx Ember look.
description: The reference sparx site: a universal, vertical-neutral starter that shows every module's formatting out of the box — a faceted shop, a journal, a booking page, a wholesale page, About and Contact — wearing the sparx Ember theme (light + dark). Install it, rebrand it to your business, and you have a polished, working site in minutes instead of a blank canvas.
